info.cls_ename: Master Program of Space System Engineering

description.describe_ch: 系統工程導論是一門旨在介紹學生系統工程基礎概念和方法的課程。學生將學習系統思維、需求分析、系統設計和驗證等關鍵概念。透過實例和案例研究，學生將理解系統開發生命周期和相關工具。此課程強調系統整體性、綜合性和創新性，培養學生解決複雜問題、跨領域合作和有效溝通的能力。無論是在航太、汽車、電子、醫療或其他工程相關領域，系統工程將成為學生成為優秀工程師的重要基礎。
description.describe_eh: Introduction to Systems Engineering is a course designed to introduce students to the fundamental concepts and methodologies of systems engineering. Students will learn key concepts such as systems thinking, requirements analysis, system design, and verification. Through examples and case studies, students will understand the system development lifecycle and associated tools. This course emphasizes the holistic, integrative, and innovative nature of systems, cultivating students' abilities to solve complex problems, collaborate across disciplines, and communicate effectively. Whether in aerospace, automotive, electronics, healthcare, or other engineering fields, systems engineering will serve as an important foundation for students to become accomplished engineers.

targets.describe_en: Enable students to understand the fundamental principles and concepts of systems engineering.

targets.describe_en: Enable students to master the skills of requirements analysis and planning and apply them to system design.

targets.describe_en: Enable students to learn to apply systems thinking for holistic problem-solving and decision-making.
